description: Record an event on a customer organization (for example trial_ending, plan_changed, seat_limit_reached) and deliver it as a contact event to the chosen recipients: owners (default; falls back to admins when there is no owner), admins (includes owners), all members, or none (timeline only). Each delivery runs sync rules and sequence triggers with `event.organization.*` properties (also available as `event.account.*`). To start a sequence once per organization rather than once per recipient, create it with enrollmentMode matching_field and enrollmentFieldPath organization.externalId. Pass eventId to make retries idempotent.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

eventId.description: Idempotency key; retries with the same id are no-ops per recipient.

externalId.description: Customer-owned account (organization/workspace) ID, e.g. the org id in your app.

occurredAt.description: Original event time in ISO 8601 format. Omit for the current time; account events still use the normal delivery pipeline with this timestamp.

properties.description: Event properties available as `event.<name>` in sequences.

name: trigger_account_event

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `trigger_account_event` MCP tool.

account.description: The account record returned by Sequenzy.

deliveries.description: Per-recipient outcome with subscriberId, email, role, success and automationsTriggered.

items.description: One item in the returned collection.

event.description: The recorded event (id, name, time) record returned by Sequenzy.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
